blocks.text: 台詞
台詞
創世王の奪い合いがしたいなら、俺もそうする。
blocks.translation: If you want to fight over the Creator King, so will I.

blocks.text: 50年前とは違う。•••今日こそ、俺が終わらせる・・・!
blocks.translation:
• This is different from 50 years ago.
• Today, I'll finish it!

blocks.text: これでもう･･･お終いだ。
気が済んだか。 帰るぞ。
blocks.translation:
• Are you satisfied?
• Let's go home.

blocks.text:
力じゃ勝てない。 まずは俺の指を剥がして折れ。 次に足の甲を踵で踏みつけろ。
反転して手を外せ。 手が残ってたら引き込んで相手を崩せ。 踏み込んで肘で突け。
blocks.translation:
• You can't win by strength.
• First, pry my fingers off and break them.
• Next, stomp the top of the foot with your heel.
• Rotate and free your hand.
• If a hand remains, pull it in and unbalance your opponent.
• Step in and strike with your elbow.

blocks.text: クジラ、お前も俺の敵か?
blocks.translation: Whale, are you my enemy too?

blocks.text:
お前は怪人になって幸せだったか? 俺は、そう思ったことは一度も無い。
新しい創世王が生まれても、 同じことを繰り返すだけだ。
blocks.translation:
• Were you happy becoming a monster? I have never once thought that.
• Even if a new Genesis King is born, they'll only repeat the same thing.

blocks.text: お前は、怪人だけの世界を望むんだな。
blocks.translation: You want a world with only monsters, don't you.

blocks.text: 断る。 お前に、 キングストーンは渡さない。
blocks.translation: I refuse. I will not give the King Stone to you.

blocks.text: 葵、大丈夫か?
信彦が創世王になるなら止める。
blocks.translation: If Nobuhiko becomes the Genesis King, I'll stop him.

blocks.text: 怪人がこの世界からいなくなる。 それで十分だろ。
blocks.translation: The monsters will be gone from this world. That should be enough.

blocks.text: お前だって何もしなかったろ。 なんでゆかりを、 ビルゲニアから守れなかった!
blocks.translation:
• You didn't do anything either.
• Why couldn't you protect Yukari from Bilgenia!

blocks.text: あの時はここで止められたよな!
blocks.translation: We were able to stop it here back then, weren't we!

blocks.text: 俺も、受け継いでるんだよ。 50年前の俺が、 ずっと見張ってる。
blocks.translation: I've inherited it too. The me from 50 years ago has been keeping watch the whole time.

blocks.text: これが最後の戦いだ。
敗北の、 意味だ。 俺がダメだったら、次を、頼む。
blocks.translation:
• It means defeat.
• If I can't do it, take the next one.

blocks.text: そんなところに座って、 創世王にでもなるつもりか。
blocks.translation: What, are you going to sit there and act like some kind of Creator King?

blocks.text:
信彦･･･。
それは、違う。 親父たちは、 俺たちに、争わせようとしたんじゃない。
blocks.translation: Nobuhiko... That's not it. Our fathers weren't trying to make us fight.

blocks.text: あのキングストーンは、あいつの物だ。 俺らが奪っていいもんじゃない。
blocks.translation: That King Stone belongs to him. It's not ours to take.

blocks.text: 乗れ。 葵、一緒にいる間だけは、俺が守ってやる。 ・・・帰るぞ。 乗れ。
blocks.translation: Get on. Aoi, while we're together I'll protect you. ...We're going home. Get on.

blocks.text:
まさか･･･ 葵なのか...。
信彦、そいつは俺がやる。 いいからどけ!
blocks.translation:
• No way... Aoi?
• Nobuhiko, I'll handle that one. Now get out of the way!

blocks.text:
よくも葵を、 怪人に･･･。 許さん!
葵 !!
blocks.translation:
• How dare you hand Aoi over to a monster... I won't forgive you!
• Aoi—!!

blocks.text: 争わない、俺たちだから、選んだ。 ・・・そう思ったら、ダメか?
blocks.translation: We chose not to fight — because that's who we are. ...Is it wrong to think that?

blocks.text: 俺はお前から奪う物なんて何もない。 だから俺に託せ。
blocks.translation: I won't take anything from you. So leave it to me.

blocks.text:
怪人は、人間だ。 誰かと出会って恋をする。 子供だって作る。
それで生きて、いつか死ぬ。 何も特別なことは無い。
blocks.translation:
• Monsters are human. They meet someone and fall in love. They even have children.
• They live that way and someday die. There's nothing special about it.

blocks.text: 生きて戦え。 戦い方を教えたはずだ。
blocks.translation:
• Live and fight.
• I should have taught you how to fight.

blocks.text: 必ず帰る。 あの村で待ってろ。
blocks.translation:
• I'll definitely come back.
• Wait for me in that village.

blocks.text: ゆかりが望んだ世界に、嘘は無いと、俺は思ってる。
blocks.translation: I believe there are no lies in the world Yukari wanted.

blocks.text: 信彦! ... 信彦・・・おい! 信彦!
怪人の命は、人間と何も変わらないと、俺はあんたに教わった。 それは今でも、変わらないのか。
blocks.translation: You taught me that a monster's life is no different from a human's. Is that still true even now?

• The speed of moving parts and the meter needle's movement can change depending on battery condition.
• The infrared sensor does not respond well outdoors in sunlight or indoors where sunlight shines in. Play indoors where sunlight does not hit the toy.
• The infrared sensor's detection range is about the distance at which a hand can rest on the moving parts (upper-left, upper-right). If the response is poor, move your hand closer to the infrared sensor.

source_blocks.text: 反転して手を外せ。 手が残ってたら引き込んで相手を崩せ。 踏み込んで肘で突け。
source_blocks.translation: Pivot and free your hand. If their hand remains, pull them in to break their balance. Step in and strike with your elbow.

source_blocks.text: お前は、怪人だけの世界を望むんだな。
source_blocks.translation: You desire a world inhabited solely by monsters, don't you?

source_blocks.text: クジラ、お前も俺の敵か?
source_blocks.translation: Whale, are you my enemy too?

source_blocks.text: 断る。 お前に、 キングストーンは渡さない。
source_blocks.translation: I refuse. I won't hand the King Stone over to you.

source_blocks.text: お前は怪人になって幸せだったか? 俺は、そう思ったことは一度も無い。
source_blocks.translation: Were you happy becoming a monster? I, for one, have never felt that way.

source_blocks.text: 新しい創世王が生まれても、 同じことを繰り返すだけだ。
source_blocks.translation: Even if a new Creation King is born, the same cycle will simply repeat.

source_blocks.text: 信彦が創世王になるなら止める。
source_blocks.translation: If Nobuhiko becomes the Creation King, I will stop him.

source_blocks.text: 怪人がこの世界からいなくなる。 それで十分だろ。
source_blocks.translation: Monsters will be gone from this world. That should be enough, right?

source_blocks.text: 俺も、受け継いでるんだよ。 50年前の俺が、 ずっと見張ってる。
source_blocks.translation: I've inherited it too. My fifty-years-ago self has been watching over me all along.

source_blocks.text: お前だって何もしなかったろ。 なんでゆかりを、 ビルゲニアから守れなかった!
source_blocks.translation: You didn't do anything either, did you? Why couldn't you protect Yukari from Bilgenia?!

source_blocks.text: あの時はここで止められたよな!
source_blocks.translation: We got stopped right here back then, didn't we?

source_blocks.text: 敗北の、 意味だ。 俺がダメだったら、次を、頼む。
source_blocks.translation: It signifies defeat. If I fail, I leave it to the next person.

source_blocks.translation: That King Stone belongs to him. It's not something we should be taking.

source_blocks.translation: Sitting there like that—do you intend to become the Creation King or something?

source_blocks.translation: Get on. Aoi—as long as we're together, I'll protect you. ...Let's go home. Get on.
It can't be... Is it Aoi...?

source_blocks.text: それは、違う。 親父たちは、 俺たちに、争わせようとしたんじゃない。
source_blocks.translation: That's not it. Our fathers didn't intend for us to fight each other.

source_blocks.text: 信彦、そいつは俺がやる。 いいからどけ!
source_blocks.translation: Nobuhiko, I'll handle him. Just get out of the way!

source_blocks.text: 争わない、俺たちだから、選んだ。 ・・・そう思ったら、ダメか?
source_blocks.translation: We chose this because we don't fight. ...Is that the wrong way to think?

source_blocks.text: よくも葵を、 怪人に･･･。 許さん!
source_blocks.translation: How dare you turn Aoi into a monster... I won't forgive you!

source_blocks.text: 俺はお前から奪う物なんて何もない。 だから俺に託せ。
source_blocks.translation: There is nothing I want to take from you. So, entrust it to me.

source_blocks.text: 怪人は、人間だ。 誰かと出会って恋をする。 子供だって作る。
source_blocks.translation: Monsters are human. They meet people and fall in love. They even have children.

source_blocks.text: 生きて戦え。 戦い方を教えたはずだ。
source_blocks.translation: Stay alive and fight. I taught you how to fight, after all.

source_blocks.text: それで生きて、いつか死ぬ。 何も特別なことは無い。
source_blocks.translation: You live like that, and someday you die. There is nothing special about it.

source_blocks.text: 必ず帰る。 あの村で待ってろ。
source_blocks.translation: I'll definitely return. Wait for me in that village.

source_blocks.text: ゆかりが望んだ世界に、嘘は無いと、俺は思ってる。

source_blocks.text: 怪人の命は、人間と何も変わらないと、俺はあんたに教わった。 それは今でも、変わらないのか。
source_blocks.translation: You taught me that a monster's life is no different from a human's. Does that still hold true?
